name: DISCONNECT
source:
Late at night, you're on a call with your best friend. When suddenly the call keeps disconnecting-- on and off-- on and off-- and your friend said that they're not even calling you at this moment.

"So who are you talking to right now?"

[From [url=https://miikojhonnyworks.itch.io/disconnect]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
深夜，你正在和你最好的朋友打电话。当电话突然断线时——断断续续——断断续续——你的朋友说他们现在甚至没有给你打电话。

“那么你现在在跟谁说话呢？”

[来自[url=https://miikojhonnyworks.itch.io/disconnect]itch.io[/url]]
